title: BADF-WP-GIT-A — Git Capability Contract Freeze
objective: Freeze badf-git as a DESIGNED-only declarative capability contract for BADF's governed trunk Git cycle and nested engineering loop, including exact Git identity, worktree isolation, branch/PR binding, private-history rewrite staleness, composed-result verification, protected integration boundaries, recovery, release/versioning and evidence semantics -- without adding a Git mutation engine, new Git authority, new gate, schema, workflow, ruleset or tool permission.
business_value: BADF already has strong individual Git controls, but the operating contract is distributed across policy, CI, evidence doctrine and operator practice. A single declarative Git contract reduces agent ambiguity while preserving the central BADF invariant that capability is not authority and source-branch success is not integration safety. Freezing the contract first prevents later Git automation from inventing permissions or bypassing composed-result evidence.
in_scope: skills/badf-git/SKILL.md: root router/constraint contract with GIT-I01..GIT-I12, governed Git cycle, nested Git loop and stop states
skills/badf-git/references/git-cycle.md: AUTHORITY -> BASELINE -> ISOLATE -> BUILD -> VERIFY -> PR -> COMPOSE -> CHALLENGE -> AUTHORIZE -> SQUASH -> RECONCILE -> RELEASE -> CLEAN -> LEARN

skills/badf-git/references/branch-pr-contract.md: one permanent main, short-lived WP branches/worktrees, proposed future wp/<CANONICAL-WORK-PACKAGE-ID>-<slug> form, PR/head binding and private rewrite rules
skills/badf-git/references/operation-authority-matrix.md: GIT-O0..GIT-O5 risk-routing classes subordinate to canonical READ/WRITE/DESTRUCTIVE/ADMIN tool governance
skills/badf-git/references/composition-and-staleness.md: source/target/merge-base/result-tree identity, canonical badf_compose reuse, evidence invalidation and ordered composition
skills/badf-git/references/recovery-contract.md: preserve-first recovery, reflog/recovery branches, forward revert for shared history, rerere candidate semantics and destructive deny-by-default
skills/badf-git/references/release-versioning.md: immutable release refs, preserve BADF-BASELINE-X.Y.Z, recommend future vX.Y.Z, governed SemVer and release-from-main semantics
skills/badf-git/references/evidence-contract.md: Git-specific bindings carried through canonical BADF evidence rather than a competing schema

governance/integrity bookkeeping required to bind and verify the nine capability files, including prior-ledger reconciliation, demand/work-package records, registry pin, structural contract verification and lockfile re-signing
out_of_scope: any scripts/badf_git.py or other Git mutation/automation executable
any new GitHub ruleset, branch protection, Actions workflow or merge-queue behavior
any change to badf/authority-matrix.json, badf/tool-registry.json or badf/mcp-registry.json that grants Git capability/authority
any schema or lifecycle/gate enforcement change
branch-name enforcement before BADF freezes one canonical machine WP-ID form repository-wide
automatic rebase, push, force update, merge, revert, tag, release or cleanup
advancing badf-git past DESIGNED; IMPLEMENTED, VALIDATED, SHADOWED, APPROVED and ACTIVE are separate future work packages
acceptance_criteria: exactly nine badf-git capability-content files exist: SKILL.md plus the eight named references; no badf-git executable/schema/workflow is introduced

GIT-I01..GIT-I12 explicitly preserve no-authority, exact-identity, isolation, rewrite-staleness, forward-repair, intentional-staging, rerere-candidate, exact-integration, immutable-release, destructive-deny and no-second-gate constraints
the governed Git cycle and nested Git loop are present and the state machine contains all required progression and hold states
the proposed branch form is documented but explicitly not enforced until one canonical machine WP-ID form is frozen repository-wide

composition evidence binds target_ref, target_base_sha, merge_base_sha, source_ref, source_head_sha, merge_method, expected_result_tree, test_set_epoch and policy_epoch and reuses the canonical BADF composition mechanism

private history rewrite invalidates affected evidence; range-diff/patch-id are diagnostic only; force-with-lease is the maximum normal rewritten-topic update boundary and bare force is not normal BADF workflow
shared/protected rollback repairs forward via a new governed change; local lost state uses reflog/recovery refs; unknown state is never destroyed merely to clean the checkout
release design preserves historical BADF-BASELINE-X.Y.Z and recommends vX.Y.Z for future releases; SemVer remains a governed decision rather than commit-prefix inference
badf-git is registry-pinned DESIGNED with allowed_tools empty and a real sha256 digest
repository integrity/structural contract checks pass without changing Git authority, canonical gate code, schemas, tool permissions or protected integration settings
permissions: write: bstBizEra/badf via work-package topic branch and pull request only
no protected integration authority is granted by this work package

rollback.method: revert the eventual squash commit through a new governed PR; do not rewrite protected main
